result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign** for simplicity and value, or **DocuSign** if you want a more established platform with broader integrations.

However, the best choice depends on how many contracts you send, whether you need document templates, and whether multiple employees need access.

Here are the options I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

- Easy to use and quick to set up.
- Templates and automated signing workflows.
- Good for client agreements, service contracts and NDAs.
- Paid plans offer unlimited signature requests.

Indicative starting price: US\$15/month, annual billing.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![Account: Docusign Inc](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dVhOhGt1QpkndwtGW47-sHNKllomPpU4vxs24pNswQkR4ZS5Rob9EH7Az_JSTVPfQ9TrCcH0e5oK9YdRNpm6RmBNsVkzxCsRHsY0XVby2paTjfNsyLWxXQIwIgoVkcHAN04Sy6nvt4MWYDJyoVDMUxLCH1igYXq2J2nv9XGNpFZ1f102xwVUVNokEDaHEjlQ?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best established platform)

- Widely recognised by businesses and customers.
- Strong document tracking and audit trails.
- Extensive integrations with other business software.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.

Indicative starting price: US\$11/month; entry plan has sending limits.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for proposals and contracts)

- Create professional-looking proposals and quotes.
- Add pricing tables and signature fields.
- Track when clients view documents.
- Useful for sales and service-based businesses.

Indicative starting price: US\$19/user/month, annual billing.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Best e-signature software | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wmbNwQd5sZcCQM_y8xDHl0CPe7pgdwCT-krxdtJ31tc_1PKqy7PiBHAl_-Gd913WdMSfKG4tvcbm87CrehlVzyh0S_XfsJoy8bGchL0mjaA3hnz0pBJgnLcUXZcQanS1poRpGWtqsda_EXu0W3Y1sz9Tm8p7il83hsR4mOfYqnnCRPXfp1UL4Ot3PT4uhG1W?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. signNow**

(Best budget option)

- Affordable signing solution.
- Reusable document templates.
- Multiple signers and workflow automation.
- Good for businesses with regular paperwork.

Indicative starting price: US\$8/user/month, annual billing.

[Visit signNow](https://www.signnow.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

- Excellent for businesses working with PDFs.
- Combines PDF editing and electronic signatures.
- Useful for document-heavy workflows.
- Strong integration with Adobe products.

Indicative starting price: US\$16.99/month for selected plans.

[Visit Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-signatures.html)

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a typical small business\:

| Your requirements | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Simple client contracts | Dropbox Sign |
| Professional business credibility | DocuSign |
| Quotes, proposals and contracts | PandaDoc |
| Lowest-cost team solution | signNow |
| PDF editing and signing | Adobe Acrobat Sign |


**One important consideration in Australia\:** Electronic signatures are generally recognised under Australian electronic transactions legislation, provided the method meets requirements around identifying the signer, showing their intention and reliability. Some document types have additional requirements. search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
